problems.title: Margin change need not order distance to the boundary or susceptibility to the stated attack
problems.source_location: Section 4.1, Eqs. (2)–(5), PDF p. 4; Section 4.2, Eq. (6), PDF p. 5.
claim: Paraphrase: Section 4.1, p. 4, interprets a larger absolute change of margin between a natural input and its adversarial example as indicating that the natural input is harder to attack, hence less vulnerable. This motivates the negative sign in Eq. (2); Eqs. (3)–(5) replace the hard maximum by log-sum-exp. Section 4.2 then favors higher scores through Eq. (6), p. 5.

The paper does not state this interpretation as a theorem with extra restrictions on logit derivatives, local linearity, or identical sensitivity across examples. Its checklist also explicitly says that it does not contain theoretical results. The claim assessed here is therefore the general explanatory interpretation of the score, not a nonexistent formal theorem.
analysis: Use ten logits on \(x\in[0,1]\), with true-class logit \(g(x)=10(x-1/2)-9\operatorname{ReLU}(x-11/20)\) and nine competing logits zero. Both \(x_A=0.51\) and \(x_B=0.90\) are correctly classified. At temperature \(\tau=5\), the soft margin is \(g(x)-\log(9)/5\), so its change equals the change of \(g\). Cross-entropy FGSM with \(\epsilon=8/255\) moves each point left by that budget without clipping. It flips \(A\), whose boundary distance is \(0.01\), while \(B\), at distance \(0.4\), remains robust throughout the allowed interval.

The score gives \(V_A=-16/51\) and \(V_B=-8/255\), and the paper’s two-point sampling formula yields \(P_A=1/4\), \(P_B=3/4\). Thus the robust point is prioritized. This valid counterexample disproves the general explanatory identification; it neither measures its frequency in trained models nor refutes the heuristic’s empirical usefulness. The filtering-specific budget was not separately established, so the witness uses the stated FGSM probe and an explicit valid evaluation budget.
result: A valid FGSM example reverses the explanatory ranking, while the paper presents a heuristic and its measured accuracy gains remain unchallenged.
repair: Describe negative margin change as an empirical heuristic that need not order true robustness; restrict performance claims to the evaluated settings. No validated efficient replacement algorithm is supplied.
problems.impact_rationale: A valid FGSM example reverses the explanatory ranking, while the paper presents a heuristic and its measured accuracy gains remain unchallenged.
problems.existing_correction_status: The local qualification or neutral-tie proposal is retained. Current accessible paper text still has the cited rule; author implementation and adoption are unestablished.

problems.title: Equation (6) is undefined when the vulnerability scores are equal
claim: Paraphrase of Eq. (6), Section 4.2, p. 5: for each training example,
\[ P_i=\frac12\left(\frac{V_i-\bar V}{D_i}+1\right),\qquad \bar V=\frac1n\sum_{j=1}^nV_j,\qquad D_i=\max_{1\le j\le n}|V_i-V_j|. \]
analysis: With affine true-class logit \(x-1/2\) and zero competing logits, the correctly classified inputs \(0.51\) and \(0.90\) have equal margin-change score \(-8/255\). Their centered scores and dispersion denominator are both zero. Equation (6) therefore contains \(0/0\), although their boundary distances differ.
result: The written probability rule omits a valid tied-score case; unavailable author code may already guard it, and no occurrence in published runs is established.
repair: The proposed clarification defines neutral equal-score probabilities and checks normalization; no released-code claim is made.
A local correction or qualification is proposed where specified; author adoption is not established.
problems.impact_rationale: The written probability rule omits a valid tied-score case; unavailable author code may already guard it, and no occurrence in published runs is established.
problems.existing_correction_status: The local qualification or neutral-tie proposal is retained. Current accessible paper text still has the cited rule; author implementation and adoption are unestablished.

impact_rationale: The counterexamples limit the heuristic’s universal vulnerability interpretation and expose an equal-score normalization case; they do not overturn the empirical adversarial-training improvements.
